description: This file defines the CanvasController class in a Kotlin-based Android project. The class manages interactions with a WebView for rendering canvas graphics, capturing bitmaps, managing debug statuses, and handling snapshot functionalities such as exporting images in different formats. It also includes utility functions for parsing JSON parameters related to canvas snapshots.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: A controller class that manages a WebView for rendering and capturing canvas content in an Android app, providing functionality for navigation, snapshots, and debug status updates.

classes.name: CanvasController.SnapshotFormat
classes.description: Enum class representing image formats for snapshots, either PNG or JPEG.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Binds a WebView to the controller and initializes its state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Unbinds the WebView from the controller.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the WebView to a specified URL or to the scaffold if URL is null or blank.

methods.name: currentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL loaded in WebView.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the WebView is currently showing the default scaffold.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status overlays.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status overlay titles and subtitles.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Should be called when page loading finishes to reapply debug and home canvas state.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the JSON state representing the home canvas and applies it to the WebView.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code within the context of the WebView.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the WebView content as a PNG, scaled to max width if specified, and returns a base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the WebView content in specified format (PNG/JPEG), quality, and max width, returning a base64 string.
